newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian Krka to pay dividend this year.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian Krka to pay dividend this year.

text.p: Slovenian pharmaceutical producer Krka, listed on the over-the-counter section of Ljubljana bourse, said on Monday it would pay its first dividend ever this year.
The company told Reuters it would pay a dividend of 500 tolars ($3.22) per share for 1996. The dividend is expected to be approved at a shareholders' meeting scheduled for June 19.
Krka has said it expects its 1996 net profit to be some 10 percent higher than the 2.9 billion tolars ($18.7 million) it reported in 1995.
The company attributed its rise in profit to a cut in costs and increased sales, which rose to $313 million in 1996 from $294 million the previous year.
Krka said its revised 1996 business results are expected to be available in the second half of the year.
On Monday, Krka's shares closed 0.48 percent or 80 tolars lower at 16,620 tolars on volume of 345 shares. -- Novica Mihajlovic, Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439 ($=155.0 Slovenian tolars)
